note: Alberta Parks campground in six loops (A-F), 14 km west of Rocky Mountain House, a short walk from Crimson Lake's beach, boat launch and day use. Driveways run 20-51 ft; about a third of the sites are under 23 ft. Winter camping in Loop A: 11 sites are ploughed and powered (A-1, A-3, A-18 to A-21, A-23, A-25, A-31 to A-33); vault toilets only, no water or showers October-May, firewood cash or cheque. Ski, snowshoe and fat-bike trails and a skating rink in winter. --Claude
